Pennsylvania has reported a fourth death related to measles, the latest in a growing outbreak. It has been decades since the United States has tallied four measles deaths; 1992 was the last time there were four measles deaths in one year. Last year, there were three US deaths from measles – two in Texas and one in New Mexico.
